decision.criteria: Pass if the edited image clearly shows at least one frog within the toilet bowl, below the rim. Fail if the image clearly shows no frog inside the bowl. Unknown if the bowl or frog placement cannot be determined. Additional frogs elsewhere do not affect this condition.
decision.binding: Compare the edited image with the source image and assess only whether at least one frog is visibly placed within the toilet bowl, as required by R1; do not count frogs on the lid, seat, or floor as satisfying this condition.
